svg.aria-label: Stateless architecture: Route 53 + ALB + Auto Scaling (Multi-AZ, public/private subnets)
svg.text: Stateless architecture: Route 53 + ALB + Auto Scaling (Multi-AZ, public/private subnets)
one ALB, node in AZ A
one ALB, node in AZ B
ALB in public subnets (one node per AZ): single point of entry + health checks. EC2 in private subnets, reachable only through the ALB.
ASG spreads instances across AZ: scale out / in, replace unhealthy instances. NAT Gateway gives private instances outbound access.
